info.name: Foundry - Campus Lost and Found API
info.description:
Campus Lost and Found Portal - API collection.

Covers: registration, login, auth, listings (create/read/update/delete), search and filters, stats, claims (submit/approve), dashboards, admin listing and user management, notifications, and the unauthorised and invalid-input cases.

No credentials are stored in this collection. Set studentEmail, studentPassword, otherEmail, otherPassword, adminEmail and adminPassword to accounts you created, and choose 'No Environment'.
